title: Getting away
translation: Getting away somewhere, anywhere, even for a little while, wakes you up. You wander around the area, and in the countryside or a mountain village almost everything is new to you. You find someone going back to the city and send a letter home: "Don't forget about this and that when you get the chance." I love that.

In a place like that you notice everything. Even the things you brought along look better: the good ones look really good. People with talent and people with good looks seem more charming than usual too. And it's lovely to slip away quietly and stay at a temple or a shrine for a few days.
original: いづくにもあれ、{暫|しば}し{旅立|たびだ}ちたるこそ、{目|め}さむる{心地|ここち}すれ。
そのわたり、ここかしこ{見|み}ありき、{田舎|ゐなか}びたる{所|ところ}、{山里|やまざと}などは、いと{目馴|めな}れぬことのみぞ{多|おほ}かる。
{都|みやこ}へたよりもとめて{文|ふみ}やる。
「その{事|こと}かの{事|こと}、{便宜|びんぎ}にわするな。」などいひやるこそをかしけれ。
さやうの{所|ところ}にてこそ、{万|よろづ}に{心|こころ}づかひせらるれ。
{持|も}てる{調度|てうど}まで、よきはよく、{能|のう}ある{人|ひと}も、かたちよき{人|ひと}も、{常|つね}よりはをかしとこそ{見|み}ゆれ。
{寺社|てらやしろ}などに{忍|しの}びてこもりたるもをかし。
literal: Wherever it may be, having set out on a journey for a while: that gives a feeling of the eyes waking up.
Walking around here and there in that area, in rustic places, mountain villages and so on, there are many things one is not used to seeing.
One looks for a messenger to the capital and sends a letter.
Writing things like 'This matter and that matter, don't forget them when there's an occasion': that is delightful.
It is in such places that one is attentive to everything.
Even the furnishings one has with one, the good ones look good, and people with talent and good-looking people look more charming than usual.
Quietly shutting oneself up at a temple or shrine is also delightful.

notes.text: 'A feeling of the eyes waking up'. Modern Japanese still says {目|め}が{覚|さ}める for an eye-opening experience. こそ … すれ: the realis form of す.
There was no post: you sent a letter with anyone who happened to be going to the capital. {便宜|びんぎ}: 'a good chance', someone going that way.
らる here means it happens by itself: 'one can't help being attentive'. Away from home, you notice things.

notes.quote: 寺社などに忍びてこもりたる
notes.text: Staying at a temple or shrine for a few days of prayer ({参籠|さんろう}) was a common short trip for people of the capital, part religion and part getting away.
